caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented, elongated oval object with a thick, rounded border rendered in brown tones. Inside the border, the background is a light beige or tan color, with visible variations suggesting a textured or wooden surface. In the center, there is a large circular motif composed of a central dark circle surrounded by concentric layers of petal-like shapes forming a flower pattern. Above and below the central motif are two large, dark brown, crescent-shaped forms, one at the top and one at the bottom. Each corner inside the border features pairs of smaller, similarly colored crescent shapes, totaling four pairs. The composition is symmetrical along its vertical axis, and the entire design is executed in shades of brown, taupe, and beige, creating a monochromatic appearance. The background around the main object is a plain, off-white color, and there is a faint handwritten text in the lower right corner.
title: Detail, Side of Confessional
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
